title: ask_artist
description: Ask the Artist for ideas for how a slide shows its content: a few proposals, each in another form (bullets, columns, key figures, a highlight, a table, a chart, a diagram), made from the slide's own text. Nothing changes: tell the person the ideas, numbered, and apply the one they choose with redesign_slide.

slide_id.description: The slide: its number in the deck (1 = first) or its ID.

wish.description: What the person wishes, in their words ("something more visual", "as a diagram"); left out: the Artist's own ideas.
